title: Business Finance
description: For young people running or planning a small business. Learn to understand your costs, price for profit, manage cash flow, budget, read simple financial statements and choose funding wisely.
outcomes: Separate personal and business money and pay yourself properly
Tell fixed costs from variable costs and work out your break-even point
Plan cash flow so you never run out of money for stock
Prepare a simple monthly business budget
Understand a basic profit and loss statement and balance sheet
Compare funding options such as savings, chamas, SACCOs and loans, and their risks
